summary: Comprehensive testing of E-Quipped AI Mastery Platform completed. All major features working correctly: Login without pre-filled credentials, Master/Admin user login, Lesson navigation with content updates, Module unlocking, Admin User Access tab with Grant/Revoke buttons, Security tab with screenshot alerts, Sandbox Open/Guided mode toggle, and Trial user restrictions. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in registration endpoint.

fixed.issue: MongoDB ObjectId was being included in response causing 520 error
fixed.fix: Added '_id' to exclusion list when returning user response

passed_tests: ✅ Login page - no pre-filled credentials (email and password fields empty)
✅ Lesson content updates when navigating between lessons (L1 → L2)
✅ Module unlocking based on lesson completion working
✅ Admin page Analytics tab displaying stats correctly
✅ Admin page User Access tab with Grant/Revoke Access buttons
✅ Admin page Security tab showing screenshot alerts
✅ Sandbox model selection (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini)
✅ Trial user sees locked modules/lessons beyond Lesson 1
✅ Trial user can access only Lesson 1 in Module 1
✅ Trial user redirected to dashboard when trying to access Lesson 2
✅ Trial Mode banner visible for unverified users
✅ Grant Access button changes user status from Trial to Verified
✅ Screenshot detection endpoint logs alerts successfully
✅ Complete & Next button navigates to next lesson with confetti celebration
